subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2824
title: Requires coordinated care organization drug outlets to dispense a seven-day supply of a prescription drug to a veteran with a disability, at no cost to the veteran, if the veteran is unable to obtain the prescription drug through the United States Department of Veterans Affairs.
headline: HB 2824 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2824 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2824 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
